title: Butterflies Pre-order Bake Sale
model: Sell prepaid packs; purchase ingredients only after the order deadline. School keeps sales less ingredients, packaging and setup.
preparation: 3 weeks; proposed collection 14:00–16:00, date to be chosen.
venue: School collection point, subject to approval
learning: Counting, following a recipe and community participation.
verified: No supplier prices, orders or donated ingredients confirmed. R18 per pack is an ingredient/packaging allowance, not a retail quote. BBC Children in Need lists bake sales among fundraising ideas. That is method inspiration only; Butterflies would run its own separate campaign.
checks: Cost a sample recipe; agree pack size, allergens, safe preparation, kitchen capacity and collection. Get enough preorders before spending. Unsold extras are not assumed.
verdict: Good first pilot: preorders control waste and cash exposure.
cost_basis: School planning allowances only; no supplier quotation or demand survey yet. Fixed costs include a small consumables/contingency allowance. Volunteer time and existing school venue are assumed donated. Any paid labour, venue hire, transport, payment fees or extra costs must be added before setting a price.

title: Butterflies Book & Toy Swap
model: Suggested R20 voluntary contribution per participating family; donated items exchanged without buying stock. Keep a free participation option.
preparation: 2–3 weeks; proposed Saturday 09:00–11:00, date to be chosen.
verified: Stock and staffing are assumed donated; no donations pledged yet.
checks: Check toy condition, small parts and age suitability; explain swapping rules. Contributions are optional, so attendance does not equal income.
verdict: Low cash risk; modest income and good parent engagement.
cost_basis: School planning allowances only; no supplier quotation or demand survey yet. Fixed costs include a small consumables/contingency allowance. Volunteer time and existing school venue are assumed donated. Any paid labour, venue hire, transport, payment fees or extra costs must be added before setting a price.

title: Sponsor a Classroom Resource
model: Ask adults or businesses to contribute R100 towards a priced resource wish list. Donations are restricted to the stated resource purpose.
preparation: 2 weeks to verify wish list; run for 4 weeks and report purchases.
learning: Improves classroom learning resources; no sales task for children.
verified: No sponsors or resource quotes confirmed. Gross donations are not unrestricted profit.
checks: Get item quotes, target and payment method; avoid tax-deduction promises. Record receipts, acknowledge sponsors privately if preferred and publish spending totals.
verdict: Strong resource funding potential if a clear wish list attracts sponsors.
cost_basis: School planning allowances only; no supplier quotation or demand survey yet. Fixed costs include a small consumables/contingency allowance. Volunteer time and existing school venue are assumed donated. Any paid labour, venue hire, transport, payment fees or extra costs must be added before setting a price.

title: Butterflies Family Picnic & Activity Morning
model: Sell a R60 family activity ticket; families bring their own picnic. Include simple school-run games, not catered meals.
preparation: 6–8 weeks; proposed Saturday 09:00–12:00, date to be chosen.
venue: School grounds if suitable; otherwise venue quote required
learning: Movement, cooperative play and family connection.
verified: R15 per family materials and R600 setup/contingency are estimates. No paid venue or catering included.
checks: Check site capacity, toilets, supervision, weather backup and access. Stop or reprice if a paid venue is necessary.
verdict: Moderate surplus only once enough families commit.
cost_basis: School planning allowances only; no supplier quotation or demand survey yet. Fixed costs include a small consumables/contingency allowance. Volunteer time and existing school venue are assumed donated. Any paid labour, venue hire, transport, payment fees or extra costs must be added before setting a price.

title: Community Skills & Class Showcase
model: Sell R40 participant places in short taster activities delivered by volunteer providers. School retains the fee after materials/setup.
preparation: 6–8 weeks; proposed Saturday 09:00–11:00, date to be chosen.
learning: Try age-appropriate art, movement or practical skills.
verified: No providers confirmed. Model assumes provider time is donated; paid presenters reduce surplus.
checks: Get provider proposals, references, age range, lesson duration, material costs, capacity and any recurring class sales terms.
verdict: Useful for discovering classes; profit depends on volunteer presenters.
cost_basis: School planning allowances only; no supplier quotation or demand survey yet. Fixed costs include a small consumables/contingency allowance. Volunteer time and existing school venue are assumed donated. Any paid labour, venue hire, transport, payment fees or extra costs must be added before setting a price.

title: Butterflies Family Fun Day & Market
model: Charge outside vendors R150 per stall. Family entry free. Model excludes speculative food sales, games income and donations.
preparation: 10–12 weeks; proposed Saturday 09:00–13:00, date to be chosen.
venue: School only if capacity and operating arrangements allow
verified: R20 per stall and R1200 shared setup are estimates; no vendors, rentals or sponsorship confirmed.
checks: Confirm demand and deposits before committing. Check power, toilets, waste, weather, stall terms and necessary operating arrangements. Paid equipment or security must be costed.
verdict: Higher workload; little surplus at ten stalls unless setup is sponsored.
cost_basis: School planning allowances only; no supplier quotation or demand survey yet. Fixed costs include a small consumables/contingency allowance. Volunteer time and existing school venue are assumed donated. Any paid labour, venue hire, transport, payment fees or extra costs must be added before setting a price.

title: VWS Firefighting Open Day — family learning event
model: A separate, optional R25 school donation from willing families. Free host admission stays free. Parents pay their own travel, adult tickets, food and extras directly; no school transport is promised.
preparation: Near-term dates are provisional school plans; check availability and school requirements before any invitation.
venue: See organiser venue and schedule below
learning: Community helpers, fire awareness and nature.
verified: Published 28 November 2026, 09:00–16:00. Children free with compulsory Quicket registration; adult paid entry needs reconfirmation. Proposed school window 09:30–12:00.
checks: VWS is itself fundraising. Obtain permission before any associated school collection; otherwise run a separate school campaign. Confirm tickets, preschool activities and parent supervision.
verdict: Education first; modest and uncertain school income. Donations may be zero.
cost_basis: R100 is an estimated school printing/admin allowance. Admission and transport are outside this donation-only model and paid by families directly. If school pays them, subtract the full cost; do not present this as an all-in family price.

venue: See organiser venue and schedule below
verified: Official organiser lists 28 November 2026, 10:00–18:00, free entry. Proposed school window 10:00–12:00; alternative to VWS on the same day.

verdict: Education first; modest and uncertain school income. Donations may be zero.

title: Museum of Childhood — family learning event
model: A separate, optional R25 school donation from willing families. Free host admission stays free. Parents pay their own travel, adult tickets, food and extras directly; no school transport is promised.
preparation: Near-term dates are provisional school plans; check availability and school requirements before any invitation.
venue: See organiser venue and schedule below
verified: Free public admission; published Wednesday–Saturday 10:00–16:00. Proposed 25 November 10:00–12:00 is not a booked museum event.
checks: Confirm preschool group admission and any activity fee. The separately advertised Grade 3–4 programme is not automatically suitable. No special story-time booking assumed.
verdict: Education first; modest and uncertain school income. Donations may be zero.

title: Iziko Planetarium — space learning event
model: Illustrative R65 learner package = R40 published school admission + R5 estimated school materials + R20 school contribution. No transport, food or adult admission included.
preparation: Plan for a later confirmed date. Iziko asks schools to apply to WCED eight weeks before a visit; check applicability to this school. The earlier 2 December suggestion is not ready to invite.
learning: Space, Earth, Sun and Moon, subject to preschool show suitability.
verified: Published school Planetarium tariff R40 per learner; public local rates differ. School rate, chaperone costs and group slot need confirmation.
checks: Confirm age fit, show duration, adult charges, booking rules, permissions and travel. At a R60 child public rate, variable cost becomes R65 and this price makes a loss after setup.
verdict: Educational value; limited fundraising margin and booking lead time.
cost_basis: Only the R40 learner tariff is published. R5 per learner and R200 setup are planning allowances. Adult admission, transport and paid staff excluded and must be quoted; school package not yet on sale.

title: Sponsored Story Week
model: Adults pledge a flat R50 for a child’s week of shared reading; no per-book competition and no requirement to pay to participate.
preparation: 2–3 weeks preparation; one school week, with optional 10-minute daily family reading.
verified: Original school proposal; no partner, pledges or materials prices confirmed. Existing books and volunteer time assumed. Read for Good documents sponsored reading as a fundraising method. This proposal is an independent Butterflies campaign, not enrolment in that UK charity programme or a claim to its branding/rewards.
checks: Use flat pledges, record collections rather than promises, keep participation free and do not publish child rankings or family donation amounts.
verdict: Promising low-cost pilot; depends on actual collected pledges.
cost_basis: School planning allowances only; no supplier quotation or demand survey yet. Fixed costs include a small consumables/contingency allowance. Volunteer time and existing school venue are assumed donated. Any paid labour, venue hire, transport, payment fees or extra costs must be added before setting a price.

title: Grow & Give Seedling Sale
model: Sell R20 seedling pots grown by the school; R8 per pot allowed for seed, growing medium and container.
preparation: 4–6 weeks growing lead time; proposed Friday collection 14:00–16:00.
learning: Plant life cycles, care and counting.
verified: R8 per pot and R120 setup are estimates; no nursery or supplier quote. Donated containers are assumed clean and suitable. RHS school-gardening guidance includes plant sales as a fundraising method; it does not establish local prices or demand.
checks: Choose non-toxic plants, obtain material prices, test germination, allow losses and take preorders. Budget is per saleable pot, not per seed planted.
verdict: Small, educational fundraiser; growing failures and low demand reduce surplus.
cost_basis: School planning allowances only; no supplier quotation or demand survey yet. Fixed costs include a small consumables/contingency allowance. Volunteer time and existing school venue are assumed donated. Any paid labour, venue hire, transport, payment fees or extra costs must be added before setting a price.

title: Intaka Island — nature learning event
model: Illustrative R45 learner package = R20 published school entrance + R5 estimated activity sheet/materials + R20 school contribution. Entrance-only model, no boat or guided programme.
preparation: Allow 6–8 weeks to confirm school requirements and booking; suggested weekday 09:30–11:00, no date reserved.
learning: Wetlands, birds and nature observation; preschool route must be agreed.
verified: Official price list: school entrance R20 per learner; three-activity education programme R66. One educator free per ten learners; extra educator R71. Cashless from 1 January 2026.
checks: Confirm preschool group eligibility, safe water-edge route, exact supervision, adult costs, weather and transport. The R66 programme cannot be sold at the R45 entrance-only scenario price.
verdict: Affordable entrance-only option; adult and transport costs can erase margin.
cost_basis: R20 school entrance is published. R5 materials and R200 setup are estimates. Additional adults, transport and paid staffing are excluded; quote them before offering a package.

title: Iziko Mobile Museum — learning at school
model: Illustrative R25 voluntary contribution per participating family, with a reserved R260 provider visit allowance plus R100 setup. Keep a free participation route.
preparation: Ask about availability 6–8 weeks ahead; proposed weekday 10:00–11:00, duration and date unconfirmed.
venue: Butterflies Educare, subject to provider acceptance
learning: Museum objects and age-adapted learning without group transport.
verified: Official tariff page lists R260 per mobile visit, while the education booking page says free. This conflict is unresolved; R260 is a provisional allowance, not a quote.
checks: Ask outreach contact sharmans@iziko.org.za / 021 481 3812 to confirm eligibility, charge, travel, capacity, topic and preschool duration. No school collection associated with the provider without agreement.
verdict: Potentially practical; verify fee conflict. If free, model surplus rises by R260.
cost_basis: Fixed R360 = disputed R260 visit tariff allowance + estimated R100 setup. No extra travel fee or paid staff assumed. Revised quote must replace this before a decision to spend.

title: Cape Town Science Centre — discovery event
model: Illustrative R110 learner package = R85 group admission + R5 estimated materials + R20 school contribution. This is a higher-cost comparator, not a free-event recommendation.
preparation: Plan 6–8 weeks ahead; suggested weekday 10:00–12:00, slot and date unconfirmed.
learning: Hands-on discovery; select preschool activities with the centre.
verified: 2026 booking form: groups larger than 15 R85 per person; one supervising adult per ten learners free; extra adults R45. R300 deposit for up to 30 learners, then R10 per additional learner.
checks: Confirm preschool programme, group size, deposit treatment, chaperones, optional workshop costs and cancellation terms. Model assumes deposit is credited to total, not a second fee; verify. Transport/adults extra.
verdict: Costs families more for the same R20 per-place contribution; lower priority for a low-cost campaign.
cost_basis: R85 group tariff is published subject to eligibility. R5 materials and R200 setup estimated. No workshop, transport, additional adult or paid staff cost included.
